system.description: Your body is made of a hard substance like stone or crystal. Work with your GM to decide your exact form, though it is likely about the shape and size of a humanoid. You do not need to eat, drink, or breathe (though you do need rest and sleep). As a being of mineral, you can take two more minor wounds than normal and ease block rolls, and your unarmed attacks deal an additional 2 damage. Due to your relative mineral inflexibility, you have an inability in dodge tasks.
